title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a single card. At the top is the product mark "ANDS Studio" with a dot icon, then the heading "Sign in" and one line of grey text: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." Below are labeled fields "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password", then a primary button "Sign in →" beside a plain-text button "New here? Create a workspace", with a smaller "Forgot password?" link below. The primary button stays disabled until both fields are filled and reads "Working…" while submitting; pressing Enter in the password field also submits. At the bottom, separated by a thin rule, sits a link: "Enterprise SSO on the roadmap →". No other roadmap or "not yet available" copy appears on the sign-in card.

Signing in against an account with multi-factor authentication enabled reveals an "Authenticator code" field (placeholder "6-digit code") with helper text explaining that "multi-factor authentication" (a hover-defined term) is enabled and to enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. A wrong code returns "That code didn't verify — codes rotate every 30 seconds; try the current one."

Clicking "New here? Create a workspace" swaps into signup mode: the heading becomes "Create your workspace", with a "What is a workspace?" tooltip ("a workspace is one isolated client company and its dossiers"). A "Who are you filing for?" choice offers "Your own company" or "On behalf of clients (CRO)", and the subtext, company-name label, and placeholder adjust accordingly ("Your company name" / "Acme Therapeutics Inc." vs "Client company name" / "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). As you type a password, live helper text shows "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.", counts down remaining characters if short, and flips to "✓ Meets the password rules." Buttons become "Create workspace →" and "Have an account? Sign in".

Choosing "Forgot password?" changes the heading to "Reset your password" and explains a one-time code (expires in 15 minutes) will be issued. You enter your email and click "Send me a code →". A notice box states this is a demo environment with no outbound email — in production the code is emailed and never displayed — and the code stays hidden behind a "Reveal demo code" button (toggling to "Hide", showing a real 8-digit code). Fields "One-time code" (placeholder "8-digit code") and "New password" follow; "Set new password →" returns you to sign-in with "Password updated — sign in with your new password." A "Back to sign in" button is always present. Errors appear as a red notice box.

After signing in, you reach the dossier manager: a top bar with "ANDS Studio", chips for "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence" and "Guided journey →", and a user chip showing your email and workspace name with "Sign out". The email/workspace part links to an "Account & security" page.

That page shows the heading "Account & security" and cards. "Who you are here" lists your email, workspace (from the account record, isolated), and role, with a "What can each role do? ▼" expander revealing a per-role permission table plus a note disambiguating owner (the platform operator/vendor), workspace admin, and the internal "tenant admin" name. "Multi-factor authentication" offers "Set up authenticator app →"; enrolling shows Step 1 (a secret plus "Copy setup link" for the otpauth URI, an acronym with a tooltip) and Step 2 (a 6-digit field, "Turn on MFA →", and a note that nothing is enforced until the code verifies). "Workspace MFA policy" shows whether MFA is required or optional; admins get a toggle. "Password & sessions" lists three facts (10-char rule, reset via "Forgot password?", 12-hour sessions), with crypto detail (salted hash, HttpOnly, audit stream) behind a "For your IT department" expander. "Deployment & data residency" states ANDS Studio is self-hosted, cross-workspace reads are refused at the API, and SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, and SIEM streaming are not yet available — each acronym hover-defined.
